Unaccented Biblia Hebraica Stuttgartensia Hebrew with Strong's numbers by Rev. Graham.
A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible
with their Renderings in the King James Version
The data came from several PD sources which were full of errors. I cleaned them by comparing them to each other and (where necessary) looking at the original.
